question: Which subdivision of ecology is sometimes defined as 'species ecology' and is also associated with physiological ecology?
solution:
The correct answer is **Autecology**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Autecology** focuses on the study of individual species in relation to their environment.
 
• It is sometimes referred to as **'species ecology'** because it deals with the ecological study of single species.
